leads.name: Tumacacori Kino heritage orchard
leads.reason: Replanted 2007 from cuttings of historic cultivars; modern trees, not ancient. 4.6 acres orchard, one place to stand but no old specimen.

leads.name: Tumacacori garden tree lines
leads.reason: NPS preservation-history part III (snippet only, not read) says the tree lines marking the garden are among the tallest and oldest on the mission; species/ages unread. Lines, not single trees.

leads.name: Tubac Presidio Chilean mesquites
leads.reason: Two uprooted in 2020 storm per Nogales International; no named surviving old tree found.

leads.name: Fremont cottonwoods along Anza Trail
leads.reason: No individually documented tree found; not searched deeply.
